fields.heading: Introducing our automatic investment tool
fields.body:
Automatic investment is a convenient way to keep your money earning while delivering positive change.

When you enable automatic investment for your account, any money you deposit will be split evenly across open investments.

Either deposit using a regular standing order, or make one-off deposits when it suits you. When you receive investment returns, these will be reinvested in the same way.

And it is simple to turn off - so you can switch to cash payments whenever it suits you.

cards.title: Spread your investments
cards.body: When you add money to your Abundance account it is invested evenly across open investments.

cards.title: Interest payments reinvested
cards.body: Your regular interest payments will also be swept into open investments in the same way.

cards.title: Keep your money working
cards.body: Your money will always be earning a return for you and helping fund real projects that improve our places.
